overview: The paper proposes DecAF, a training-free method for video reasoning segmentation that refines noisy MLLM attention maps via contrastive object-background fusion and complementary video-frame fusion, followed by attention-guided SAM2 prompting with an attention consistency score to produce fine-grained masks.

modules.name: Data Preprocessing and Sampling
modules.description: Handles video input processing including uniform frame sampling, image transformations for MLLM compatibility (e.g., native resolution or tiling), and the construction of object-focused and background-focused prompt templates based on the input expression.

modules.name: MLLM Inference and Attention Extraction
modules.description: Executes the Multimodal Large Language Model forward pass for both video and frame modalities, extracting intermediate attention weights from specified transformer layers and capturing the model's textual responses for object category identification.

modules.name: Attention Rollout with Vision-Aware Normalization
modules.description: Implements the attention rollout mechanism to aggregate attention weights across layers. Includes the vision-aware head-wise weighted aggregation (V-Max) to prioritize heads with strong visual attention and recursively accumulates the attention matrices to compute the final visual token influence map.

modules.name: Contrastive Object-Background Attention Fusion
modules.description: Refines the raw attention rollout maps by subtracting the background attention map (derived from a background-focused prompt excluding the target object) from the object attention map (derived from an object-focused prompt). Applies Gaussian smoothing and min-max normalization to highlight the target object while suppressing visual attention sinks.

modules.name: Complementary Video-Frame Attention Fusion
modules.description: Integrates temporal and spatial cues by fusing video-level attention maps (capturing temporal context) with frame-level attention maps (capturing fine-grained spatial details). Handles multi-scale alignment by upscaling low-resolution video attention maps and performing frame-wise normalization followed by averaging.

modules.name: Coarse Attention Mask Generation
modules.description: Converts the refined spatio-temporal attention maps into binary coarse segmentation masks using adaptive thresholding techniques. Serves as a baseline segmentation output and a precursor for generating SAM2 prompts.

modules.name: SAM2 Point Prompt Generation
modules.description: Extracts spatial point prompts from the fused attention maps by selecting visual tokens whose attention scores exceed a defined threshold. Maps the token grid coordinates to high-resolution image space to serve as input queries for the SAM2 model.

modules.name: SAM2 Inference and Mask Propagation
modules.description: Executes the SAM2 model using the generated point prompts. Performs frame-wise prompting and propagates the generated masks across the temporal dimension to produce video mask tracklets, while recording the internal confidence scores for each tracklet.

modules.name: Mask Tracklet Scoring and Selection
modules.description: Filters false positive mask tracklets by computing a combined score comprising the SAM2 confidence, the underlying attention score, and a novel attention consistency score (sac) that measures the alignment between the predicted mask and high-attention regions. Applies Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) based on the object score to remove redundant masks.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Calculation
modules.description: Computes the standard Video Object Segmentation evaluation metrics, specifically Region Similarity (J), Contour Accuracy (F), and their mean (J&F), by comparing the predicted dense masks against the ground truth annotations.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the execution of various ablation studies, managing configurations to enable/disable core components like contrastive fusion, complementary fusion, multi-scale inputs, different rollout starting layers, and varying threshold values for SAM prompting.

modules.name: Visualization and Result Analysis
modules.description: Generates qualitative visualizations including raw attention maps, refined attention maps, coarse attention masks, SAM query points, and final dense masks overlaid on video frames. Facilitates error analysis and comparison with ground truth and baseline methods.
